msgs: 71 laps, 84 passes on track and no safety car

a: McLaren, from P1 on the grid

asks.q: was it actually good or are you being nice
a: 84 passes on track, not counting the ones in the pit lane

asks.q: i know nothing about f1, start there
a: ok so 21 cars, lined up roughly in qualifying order, less any grid penalties
it started wet, so the usual two-compound rule didn't apply today

msgs: 26 places changed hands before they even finished lap 1

asks.q: why is the start always so mad
a: cold tyres, cold brakes, full fuel tank and everybody going for the same gap
it's the only moment of the race where the whole field is that close

asks.q: does the start decide the race
a: track position is everything on most circuits, you lose places on lap 1 and you can spend a long time stuck behind someone slower

msgs: lap 2 was the busiest of the whole race

a: yeah, only moves made on track count here
swaps in the pit lane and stuff behind the safety car are left out
honestly not sure, the data only tells me he stopped, not why
teams give the detail later, if at all
